title: Sound Map of the Guadiana
description: Explore trails, listening spots, and highlighted species across the Guadiana Natural Park. Select a route to display the path and discover the voices you can expect to hear.
side_panel_title_all: Choose a trail to see details
side_panel_description_all: Use the selector to focus the map on a specific trail or location. You can change the basemap style and toggle layers whenever needed.
side_panel_description: A selection of emblematic species you are more likely to hear along this sound trail.
map_instructions: Use the selector to centre the map on a trail or listening point.
map_instructions_secondary: The locate button shows your approximate position to help you navigate in the field.
no_species: There are no featured species for this trail yet.
